name: prompt-composer
title: Prompt Composer
description: The image generator's composer: a borderless prompt box, a model chip, an aspect-ratio chip, a 1-4 image stepper and the lime glossy Generate button with a live credit cost (model price x image count). Takes the model list, an optional credit balance and an onGenerate callback.

meta.use_when: You need the place where someone writes a prompt, picks a model, aspect ratio and number of images, and starts an image generation that spends credits.
